name: staged_motion
interface: Move one arm from its CURRENT measured TCP to goal=[world x,y,z] using short bounded straight translations, preserving the current gripper orientation and closure. Goal must come from the CURRENT observed geometry, never a remembered scene coordinate. This is a robot-motion composition, not a detector, grasp planner, or collision-free guarantee. Arguments: arm, goal, reserve_actions; optional gripper_value performs one open/close at the END and returns for visual review (0 closes with12 minimum steps,1 opens with6). Plan the correct orientation separately before calling. Use separate calls for approach-and-close, lift, transport, and lower-and-release; inspect current wrist RGB after every grasp/release and important transfer. Choose a clear route ABOVE obstacles and the bin rim before horizontal transport. A surface label is not the center of a round body. Confirm bottle retention after a small lift. Do not release a bottle merely because its projection overlaps the bin: verify that the actual bottle is inside the observed opening. Right-side bottles that cannot reach the bin require a reachable supported handover, not repeated midair reach attempts. A failure stops remaining stages. Each stage is freshly checked against current robot state; native actions and the recovery reserve still apply. Contract-tested only, no task-success assertion.
